name: hornguard
description: a Hornguard, a stocky red-bearded dwarf in a steel nasal helmet with gold bands and steel plate armour with brown leather straps, a long wooden lance with a steel head couched under his RIGHT arm and pointing forward to the upper-right, riding a big grey war rhinoceros with two steel-capped horns, a steel-and-gold chamfron and steel barding over a brown leather harness with gold rivets, and pale toenails
hands: the lance stays couched under the dwarf's right arm on the screen-left side, gripped in his right fist, its steel point forward past the rhino's horns; his left hand holds the reins on the screen-right side

strike.4: contact: the dwarf leans far forward over the rhino's neck with his weapon arm fully extended, the lance thrust out along a line to the lower-right, its point the farthest point of the figure; the rhino lunges far forward toward the lower-right, low, its horned head stretched out and its horns leading, hind legs driving; both face the lower-right
